Pikachu.description: Build Static with electric shots, dash to safety, then detonate marks with a heavy attack.

Charmander.description: Burn foes with embers, punish with claws, and control lanes with sustained fire.

Squirtle.description: Guard through a tackle, slow foes with water, and line up a heavy cannon shot.

Bulbasaur.description: Root and slow with vines and seeds, then drain a controlled target to recover health.

Gengar.description: Poison an area, exploit debuffed foes with Hex, and shadow-step into a recovering boss.

Alakazam.description: Build Focus while kiting, consume it with Psychic, or cleanse and recover when pressured.

Machamp.description: Link punches into a three-hit stagger, then cash the combo into a heavy interrupt.

Eevee.description: Pressure with seeking stars, dash into a speed boost, then commit to a recoil strike.

Snorlax.description: Slow foes with Lick, guard through a tackle, slam an opening, or risk Rest to recover.

Charizard.description: Burn at range, shove foes away with a wing sweep, then fan or sustain flames.

Blastoise.description: Slow and push with water, interrupt up close with Bite, then fire a piercing cannon.

Venusaur.description: Pressure with leaves, root with vines, then choose life drain or a committed solar beam.

Arcanine.description: A fast circling hunter that commits to flame charges.

Ninetales.description: Circles at range and blinks away before foxfire fans.

Rapidash.description: Long straight charges alternate with strafing fire lanes.

Jolteon.description: Rapid side steps, electric sweeps, and radial volleys.

Raichu.description: Orbits and releases offset electric rings and tracking bursts.

Electabuzz.description: Closes in behind electric fans, then lunges and slams.

Vaporeon.description: Retreats into water fans, predicted bursts, and a fresh angle.

Gyarados.description: Sweeping jets alternate with long surges and two-wave rings.

Lapras.description: Slowly circles while placing ice bursts and crossfire lanes.

Cloyster.description: A strafing shell that fires needle fans and offset radial waves.

Scyther.description: High mobility, flanking lunges, and chained close cuts.

Pinsir.description: Advances into lunges, two-hit combos, and ground slams.

Golem.description: Heavy charges, rockfall circles, and delayed shockwaves.

Rhydon.description: Long committed charges followed by a punishable recovery.

Nidoking.description: Chases between poison spreads and staggered ground bursts.

Nidoqueen.description: Defends space with shockwaves, predicted earth bursts, and charges.

Dragonite.description: Sweeping dragon fire and fast lunges from circling flight.

Aerodactyl.description: Fast flanking movement, diving lanes, and rockfall bursts.

Mewtwo.description: Teleports into new angles, then pauses to recover before unleashing psychic lanes.

Articuno.description: Circles in flight, placing slow zones and sweeping ice lanes.

Thunder Shock.description: Fast electric ball. Builds up to 3 Static marks for 4.5 seconds.

Quick Attack.description: Dash and strike forward; brief invulnerability and a short speed boost.

Electro Ball.description: A large electric orb. Consumes Static marks for up to 66% bonus damage.

Thunderbolt.description: Lock your firing direction, then release a piercing electric lance. Can interrupt a boss windup.

Ember.description: Fireball that burns non-Fire targets for three ticks.

Scratch.description: Lunging claw sweep. Deals 35% more damage to burning targets.

Flamethrower.description: Three short flame cones. Pressure a lane and keep your target burning.

Flame Burst.description: An arcing fireball leaves a burning patch for 3 seconds.

Water Gun.description: Quick water shot that briefly slows its target.

Tackle.description: A forward body dash. Reduces incoming damage by 45% for 1.5 seconds.

Water Pulse.description: Large slowing water orb with strong knockback. Create space or set up a heavy shot.

Hydro Pump.description: A delayed piercing water cannon. Recoil shifts you backward; interrupts a boss windup.

Vine Whip.description: Long forward vine sweep. Briefly roots the target, then slows it.

Razor Leaf.description: Fast piercing leaf blade. Reliable ranged pressure.

Seed Bomb.description: Heavy seed leaves a slowing bramble patch. Hits slowed or rooted foes 25% harder.

Giga Drain.description: Seeking orb that heals for 45% of actual damage. Deals 25% extra to slowed or rooted foes.

Hex.description: Homing spirit. Deals 30% extra damage to a poisoned, burned, slowed, or rooted target.

Shadow Ball.description: Large seeking shadow orb. Long-range pressure with light tracking.

Sludge Bomb.description: Arcing poison bomb leaves a toxic pool. Set up Hex against poisoned foes.

Confusion.description: Piercing psychic dart. Builds Focus marks to empower Psychic.

Psycho Cut.description: Throw a piercing crescent while stepping backward. Builds Focus for Psychic.

Psychic.description: Delayed psychic lance. Consumes Focus marks for bonus damage and interrupts a boss windup.

Recover.description: Recover 25% HP, clear burn/poison/slow/root, and briefly reduce incoming damage.

Mach Punch.description: Gap-closing punch. Builds a short-lived combo; every third combo hit staggers.

Bullet Punch.description: Fast steel strike with a short guard window. Builds the melee combo.

Dynamic Punch.description: Heavy stunning lunge. Consumes combo stacks for bonus damage and interrupts a boss windup.

Close Combat.description: Three-hit close combo. Stay in reach; each hit advances your combo chain.

Swift.description: Three seeking stars. Reliable pressure while moving; total damage is split across the burst.

Double-Edge.description: A heavy committed dash. Deals 20% extra during a speed boost, but inflicts 20% damage recoil.

Lick.description: Short ghost-type strike. Slows the target to set up Body Slam.

Body Slam.description: Staggering shockwave all around you. Punishes slowed foes and interrupts a boss windup.

Rest.description: Heal 30% HP and clear statuses, then remain vulnerable during a 0.9-second recovery.

Wing Attack.description: A lunging wing sweep that pushes the target away.

Fire Blast.description: Delayed five-fireball fan. Heavy pressure that burns non-Fire targets.

Bite.description: Close dark-type bite. A fast opportunity to interrupt a boss windup.

Solar Beam.description: Commit to a long windup for a piercing solar lance. Stronger against slowed foes.

Sucker Punch.description: Shadow-step forward and strike. Deals 35% extra while a boss is recovering.
